plan.planning_summary: Iteration 2 refinement of route_01 (22-layer ZnS/MgF2 dual-cavity dual-band filter). All routes implement the feedback directive: physics-constrained initialization clamping dielectric spacer and cavity layers to [50, 150] nm thickness window prior to optimization. This enforces quarter-wave optical path lengths around target resonant frequencies (3.3 μm and 4.25 μm), seeding the population onto the primary resonance manifold rather than scattering across arbitrary multi-order interference regimes. Three complementary routes explore layer count variations (20, 22, 24) while preserving the dual-cavity topology principle verified in iteration_01.

routes.title: 22-Layer Dual-Cavity Filter with Physics-Constrained Thickness Initialization
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Clamping spacer and cavity layer thicknesses to [50, 150] nm during initialization will seed the optimizer onto the primary resonance manifold, reducing convergence time and improving final target score compared to unbounded initialization, while preserving the 22-layer dual-cavity topology that achieved 0.955 target score in iteration_01.
routes.design_principle: Quarter-wave optical thickness initialization around target center wavelengths (3.3 μm and 4.25 μm) for cavity/spacer layers, with gradient-based thickness optimization over all 22 layers under the same physical bounds as route_01.
routes.proposed_topology: Air | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | CaF2 substrate (22 finite layers)
design_variables: All 22 layer thicknesses with gradient optimization
Initialization clamped to [50, 150] nm for cavity/spacer layers
soft_objectives: Maximize transmittance in 3.25-3.35 μm and 4.20-4.30 μm bands
Minimize transmittance in 2.50-3.10 μm and 4.45-5.00 μm bands
Improve target score beyond 0.955 achieved in route_01
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness control at nanometer scale required
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack principle for bandpass filters
Transfer matrix method for multilayer optimization
Physics-constrained initialization reduces search space to resonance manifold
expected_advantages: Faster convergence due to informed initialization
Higher final target score from better starting point
known_risks: Initialization window may be too restrictive for some cavity orders
May converge to local optimum within constrained manifold
routes.execution_request_english: Optimize a 22-layer planar multilayer filter on CaF2 substrate with Air incidence. Stack sequence: Air | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | CaF2. All 22 layer thicknesses are optimization variables. Apply physics-constrained initialization: clamp all cavity and spacer layer thicknesses to [50, 150] nm range before gradient optimization begins. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with uniform physical bounds. Score candidates on transmittance: high in 3250-3350 nm and 4200-4300 nm bands, low in 2500-3100 nm and 4450-5000 nm bands. Normal incidence, unpolarized illumination. No metal layers permitted. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 2500-3100 nm, 3250-3350 nm, 4200-4300 nm, 4450-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 3.25-3.35 um and 4.20-4.30 um bands; Low transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 24; No metal layers; Conventional depositable infrared inorganic dielectric materials only.
routes.revision_reason: Implements feedback directive: physics-constrained initialization clamping spacer/cavity layers to [50, 150] nm to seed population onto primary resonance manifold, while preserving the verified 22-layer dual-cavity topology from route_01.

routes.title: 24-Layer Dual-Cavity Filter with Physics-Constrained Initialization
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Increasing layer count from 22 to 24 while applying physics-constrained initialization will improve out-of-band blocking in the 2.50-3.10 μm and 4.45-5.00 μm regions without sacrificing passband transmittance, as additional quarter-wave pairs enhance stopband rejection per interference filter theory.
routes.design_principle: Extend the dual-cavity topology by adding one high-low index pair at each mirror section (2 additional layers total), maintaining quarter-wave initialization for all cavity/spacer layers in [50, 150] nm window.

research_influence: Evidence s2-chunk:CorpusId:227248144 confirms that more layers produce steeper spectral slopes and higher blocking but transmission tends to drop - motivates testing 20/22/24 layer variants.
Evidence s2-chunk:CorpusId:17683472 establishes thickness constraints for manufacturability - supports testing reduced layer count for practical deposition.
Evidence s2-chunk:CorpusId:235711786 supports TMM-based dual-objective optimization with thickness as optimization variable - validates gradient_thickness optimizer approach.
Evidence s2-chunk:CorpusId:139773493 demonstrates Ge/Nb2O5 bandpass filters for gas sensing with center wavelength and bandwidth as critical parameters - validates dual-band optimization objective.
unresolved_decisions: Optimal layer count between 20-24 for balancing performance and manufacturability remains to be determined by experimental comparison.
Whether physics-constrained initialization provides measurable improvement over unbounded initialization requires direct comparison of route_02 vs route_01 results.
plan.stop_if_all_routes_fail: Stop after the bounded route portfolio is exhausted or further search stagnates. Return every physically verified candidate and report soft objective trade-offs without a performance admission threshold.
